usedFor: Shopify captures customers and their contact details; ApexVerify checks whether those emails or phone numbers are real. A “New Customer” in Shopify can run “Verify Email or Phone” so bad addresses are caught early.

bestTemplate.name: “New Customer” in Shopify, then “Verify Email or Phone” in ApexVerify
bestTemplate.why: Each customer gets a quality result as they sign up, and you choose the verification type and target country.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” is polling, so a check on that email runs after the next poll. Triggers like “New Product” carry no contact to verify, so keep this on customers.
